name: toolhub
description: ToolHub — privacy-first free online tools (Cloudflare Workers, static-first).

scripts.test: node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/core.v2.test.mjs && node tests/core.v3.test.mjs && node tests/core.v4.test.mjs && node tests/worker.test.mjs && node tests/sync-skills.test.mjs && node tests/repo-policy.test.mjs && node tests/cpu-budget.test.mjs && node tests/trending.test.mjs
scripts.verify:release: npm run build && npm run check:static && npm test && npm run selfcheck
scripts.deploy: node build/release-check.mjs && npm run verify:release && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:all: npm run build:skills && npm run build && node build/sync-trending.mjs
